description.value: Once per encounter, as a free action, run one installed augment one Grade above its rating until the end of your turn, applying the numeric benefit of that higher Grade. Each use adds 1 to your Drift score until you next make a full night’s rest. If temporary Drift pushes you over a threshold you have not permanently reached, you suffer that threshold’s effects until you rest.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-encounter free action to run an installed augment above its Grade has no engine hook: no rule element grants a new usable action (same absence as Reactive Shield/Second Wind), and the Drift increase it causes is Cinderfall's own bookkeeping with no actor-schema representation.
